_readme: Curated pictures the princesses may show a child. Nothing here is fetched
at runtime and no image search is ever run, because you cannot guarantee
what a search returns and this is in front of a four-year-old.
Every entry MUST record where the file came from and under what licence.
That is not bureaucracy: this repo is public and the app is paid, so an
unlicensed photo is a real problem, and 'I found it online' is not a
licence. If the source and licence are not filled in, the picture is not
used, and the checker will say so.
Safe sources, in rough order of how little thought they need:
NASA                  public domain. Moon, planets, Earth from orbit.
NOAA / USGS           public domain. Tides, weather, rocks, fossils.
Pexels / Pixabay      free for commercial use, no attribution needed.
Wikimedia Commons     per-file licence, check each one, many need credit.
Not safe: anything from a web search, Getty, Google Images, or a site that
does not state a licence on the file itself.
